# NationMaster

> > NationMaster provides comprehensive international statistics and country comparisons across economy, crime, demographics, health, environment, geography, labor, and government metrics.

NationMaster aggregates data from authoritative sources to enable side-by-side comparisons of countries worldwide. The platform covers hundreds of statistical indicators spanning economic performance, social demographics, crime rates, environmental resources, and geopolitical information for nations including the United States, Australia, Canada, Finland, Sweden, and many others.

## Economic Statistics

- [Per capita GDP](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Economy/Per-capita-GDP): Per capita GDP rankings comparing economic output across countries
- [Unemployment Rate](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Economy/Unemployment-rate): Labor market unemployment rates led by Zimbabwe, Nauru, Liberia
- [Real Interest Rate](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Economy/Real-interest-rate): Real interest rates comparison including deposit and lending rates
- [Technology Index](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Economy/Technology-index): Technology development index rankings for US, Taiwan, Finland, Sweden

## Crime & Safety Statistics

- [Assaults](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Crime/Assaults): Assault crime rates for Scotland, Northern Ireland, Swaziland, South Africa
- [Serious Assault Rate](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Crime/Serious-assault-rate): Serious assault crime rates comparing South Africa, Swaziland, Zimbabwe
- [Rape Rate](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Crime/Rape-rate): International comparison of rape crime statistics by country
- [Prosecution Rate](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Crime/Prosecution-rate): Criminal prosecution rates for violent crimes across countries

## Labor & Workforce

- [Labor Force](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Labor/Labor-force): Workforce size comparison led by China, India, EU, United States

## Demographics & Society

- [Couples with Children](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/People/Couples-with-children): Compares household composition data for couples with children globally
- [Households with More Than 5 People](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/People/Households-with-more-than-5-people): Large household size demographics across Ireland, Australia, Italy, Canada
- [Patriotism](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/People/Patriotism): National pride statistics for Venezuela, Ireland, South Africa, India

## Environment & Natural Resources

- [Total Renewable Water Resources](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Environment/Total-renewable-water-resources): Renewable water resources rankings led by Brazil, Russia, Indonesia, China
- [Commercial Energy Use](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Energy/Commercial-energy-use): Per capita commercial energy consumption led by Qatar, Iceland, Kuwait
- [Endangered Species Protection](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Environment/Endangered-species-protection): Wildlife conservation and endangered species protection rankings by country

## Geography & Territory

- [Maritime Claims](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Geography/Maritime-claims): Territorial waters and exclusive economic zone claims by country
- [Land Boundaries](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Geography/Land-boundaries): International border and territorial boundary length statistics

## Optional

- [Duration of Hospitalisation](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Health/Duration-of-hospitalisation): Hospital length of stay comparison for Switzerland, Netherlands, France
- [Diplomatic Representation in the US](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Government/Diplomatic-representation-in-the-US): Embassy and consular representation data for countries in the US
- [Major Language(s)](https://www.nationmaster.com/country-info/stats/Language/Major-language(s)): Major and official languages data for Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Andorra
